text: 10 OVERDOSAGE No specific treatment for pitavastatin tablets overdose is known. Contact Poison Control (1-800-222-1222) for latest recommendations. Hemodialysis is unlikely to be of benefit due to high protein binding ratio of pitavastatin tablets.
